# MANN+HUMMEL Air Filtration

> > MANN+HUMMEL delivers comprehensive air filtration solutions for healthcare, industrial, commercial, and life sciences applications with HEPA, ULPA, and HVAC technologies.

MANN+HUMMEL Air Filtration specializes in advanced air filtration systems meeting international standards (ISO, Eurovent, DIN, ATEX) for cleanrooms, operating theatres, pharmaceutical labs, food production, and HVAC systems. The site provides product catalogs, technical documentation, industry-specific solutions, and case studies demonstrating energy efficiency and air quality improvements.

## Core Products & Solutions

- [MANN+HUMMEL Air Filtration for cleaner air](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk.html): MANN+HUMMEL homepage showcasing HEPA filters, TAV systems, and air filtration solutions.
- [MANN+HUMMEL air filters for cleaner indoor air](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters.html): Main product category page for HEPA filters and HVAC solutions with ISO/Eurovent standards.
- [EPA, HEPA and ULPA filters for cleaner air](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/epa-hepa-ulpa-filters.html): High-efficiency EPA, HEPA, and ULPA filters meeting DIN EN 1822-1:2009 for cleanrooms.
- [Ventilation filters for HVAC systems by MANN+HUMMEL](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters.html): HVAC ventilation filters including bag, pleated, and compact filters with Eurovent ratings.

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [MANN+HUMMEL air filters for your industry](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries.html): Industry-specific air filtration solutions for healthcare, food, electronics, and life sciences.
- [HEPA and cleanroom filters for operating theatres](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/hospital-air-purification-medical-filtration.html): HEPA/ULPA filters and TAV ceiling systems for hospital operating theatres and medical facilities.
- [LTF ceiling systems & HEPA filters for OR & hospitals](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/hospital-air-purification-medical-filtration/clean-room-filters-hepa-filters-for-operating-theatres.html): LTF ceiling systems with HEPA filters for operating rooms meeting DIN 1946-4 standards.
- [Lab and pharma filters for high standards](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/lab-filters-for-life-science-and-pharmaceutical-industry.html): HEPA/ULPA cleanroom filters for pharmaceutical labs and life sciences with ISO 846, VDI 6022.
- [Air filters for food safety and hygiene](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/air-filters-for-food-safety-beverage-control.html): HVAC filters for food and beverage production meeting EC 1935 and EU 10:2011 standards.
- [Protecting microelectronics with air filtration](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/air-filters-protecting-microelectronics-optics-safety.html): Molecular filters protecting microelectronics and semiconductors from airborne contamination.

## HVAC Filter Types & Specifications

- [Greater building efficiency with air filtration](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filtration-industries/hvac-filters-for-energy-efficient-buildings.html): HVAC air filters for commercial buildings with focus on energy efficiency and indoor air quality.
- [HVAC panel and pleated filters by MANN+HUMMEL](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/hvac-pleated-panel-filters.html): Pleated panel filters including Airpanel Eco and Select series for optimal HVAC performance.
- [Bag filters for ventilation by MANN+HUMMEL](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/hvac-bag-filters.html): HVAC bag filters including Airpocket Eco series for energy-efficient air filtration.
- [Compact filters for HVAC by MANN+HUMMEL](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/hvac-compact-filters.html): Compact HVAC filters including Aircube Eco and Select series for space-efficient installations.
- [Extended Surface HVAC Box Filters](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/hvac-box-filters.html): Box filters including Aircube N Eco and molecular filters for diverse filtration needs.
- [ATEX filters for safe, demanding installations](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/atex-filters.html): ATEX-certified filters for explosive environments including Aircurve Pro and Aircube N Pro.
- [Filter mats, media and pads for cleaner air](https://airfiltration.mann-hummel.com/en-uk/air-filters/hvac-filters/filter-media-filter-pads-filter-mats.html): Filter media and pads including Airmat Select and Airroll Select product lines.
